chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Ali al-Asraq, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) bequeathed to Ali (peace be upon him) at the time of his passing, saying: O Ali! Do not let the peasants be oppressed in your presence, and do not let the taxes increase upon the land you have placed upon it, and do not let forced labor be upon a Muslim' — meaning the employee.
ai.seo_question: What were the Prophet's final instructions to Imam Ali regarding taxation and labor?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophet’s final directive to Imam Ali regarding fiscal justice, specifically prohibiting the imposition of *sukhrah* (forced labor or billeting) upon Muslim laborers. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on protecting the economic rights of the working class and ensuring that governance does not burden the populace with arbitrary levies or compulsory service.
